# Late night reading 11-19-26

## Thermodynamic Binding Networks 

- Strand displacement and tiling processes are always not the equilibrium or only favored state at infinity time limit.
  Ideally, one wants to design reactions such that a definitive product is thermodynamically favored.

- New model of computing, in which computation is driven by the thermodynamic forces of entropy and enthalpy. 

- The idea is we don't want a reaction to always only be partially complete. We want it to go to completion. 

- While the trade-off between entropy and enthalpy is complex, TBN is based on the special case where enthalpy is
  infinitely more favorable then entropy. Reminder that here, enthalpy is measured as the number of base pairs and
  entropy is measured as the number of separate complexes.
